title: Expand PMD ruleset for Java bridge code
description:
The PMD ruleset in Mage.Client.Bridge/pmd-ruleset.xml currently has 8 low-noise rules (unused code, empty statements, etc.). Consider adding more rules that catch real bugs without too much noise:

- AvoidReassigningParameters: catches subtle mutation bugs
- SwitchStmtsShouldHaveDefault: missing default cases
- MissingBreakInSwitch / ImplicitSwitchFallThrough: accidental fall-through
- CloseResource: unclosed streams and connections

Each rule should be added individually and tested against the current codebase to gauge noise level before committing.
